findings.note: upstream: quarto-cli#14378 (scrollable code blocks lack tabindex)
third-party: dygraphs — can't override the axis-label color with CSS (inline style set by dygraph.js); needs rstudio/dygraphs to upgrade to dygraph.js >= 2.0

third-party: Observable Plot — axis tick/grid <g> has aria-label with no role; fixed in Plot 0.6.14 (observablehq/plot#2018), but Quarto bundles Plot 0.6.11 (quarto-cli#14934). Prune when Quarto updates Plot.
